d:
In this episode, crews face challenges as they try to get their gold mining operations running. Tony and his crew deal with stuck equipment in the Midas Cut, Parker’s crew starts their second wash plant, and Greg Gibson’s crew struggles with building a new wash plant.

About Gold Rush
Motivated by a depressed economy, hard-working gold miners get to work both in America and across the globe in an attempt to strike it rich.
